## Vancouver Outdoor Photography Window

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/camera.svg

You’ve got one clear standout day and one solid backup. For outdoor photography, the biggest drivers here are dry conditions, cloud cover, and soft light.

## Best Shooting Day and Backup Plan

| Date | Forecast | Photo Read | Why it matters |
|---|---|---|---|
| 11/4 | 10°C / 5°C, sunny, 10% | **Best shooting day** | Lowest rain risk and the cleanest conditions for landscapes, cityscapes, and long walks between locations. |
| 11/5 | 11°C / 6°C, partly cloudy, 20% | **Best backup day** | Still fairly dry, with clouds that can help soften harsh sun and add texture to skies. |
| 11/3 | 8°C / 3°C, cloudy, 40% | Usable if needed | Overcast light can be flattering for portraits and forest scenes, but the higher rain chance makes it less reliable. |
| 11/2 | 9°C / 4°C, rain, 85% | Poor choice | Wet conditions and likely flat contrast; better for moody rain shots only if you want that look. |
| 11/6 | 7°C / 2°C, rain, 70% | Poor choice | Colder and wetter, with limited flexibility for outdoor shooting. |

## Photography Read for Each Day

- **Best day: 11/4**
  - Strongest option for consistent outdoor coverage.
  - Good for golden-hour city shots, waterfront scenes, and any location that benefits from clear visibility.

- **Best backup: 11/5**
  - Good balance of comfort and usable light.
  - Partly cloudy skies can reduce glare and give you more even exposure than full sun.

- **Quick lighting note**
  - **Sunny/partly cloudy days** are best for architecture, skyline, and color-rich scenes.
  - **Cloudy days** are better for portraits, close-ups, and forest or street detail because shadows stay softer.
  - In November, plan for **short daylight and lower sun angle**, so early morning and late afternoon will be your best shooting windows.

- **Quick clothing note**
  - Bring **layers**, a **light waterproof shell**, and **water-resistant shoes**.
  - On 11/2 and 11/6, add **umbrella protection for gear** and a **lens cloth**.
  - Even on the better days, Vancouver can feel damp and cool, so gloves and a warm mid-layer are smart for longer sessions.

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Check Vancouver forecast](https://weather.gc.ca/city/pages/bc-74_metric_e.html)
Action: [Button: Plan golden hour](https://www.timeanddate.com/sun/canada/vancouver)

- Environment and Climate Change Canada: https://weather.gc.ca/city/pages/bc-74_metric_e.html
- Sun times for Vancouver: https://www.timeanddate.com/sun/canada/vancouver
